name: BackdoorVR
summary: Backdoor VR is an immersive virtual reality game that transports players into the eerie and enigmatic world of the Backrooms, an endless maze of eerily familiar rooms and corridors. As an unwitting protagonist who has "no-clipped" out of reality, your primary objective is to escape. The game features cutting-edge VR technology with hyper-realistic graphics and atmospheric soundscapes that enhance the sense of dread and isolation.
